identity.name: OpenMM DHFR explicit-solvent PME concurrent simulation throughput
identity.publication: Hsu, Clark and Paulsen, Maximizing OpenMM Molecular Dynamics Throughput with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service, NVIDIA Technical Blog, 2025-06-04

outcome_definition.definition: Sum of the two concurrently measured per-process ns_per_day values. Published article reports total throughput; per-process rates come from benchmark.py.

required_inputs.reason: Per-input licence scope not explicitly established by inspected sources.

article.reason: No article reuse licence established; citation only.

intended_use_permissions.intended_use: Execute public benchmark locally and assess throughput; no redistribution planned.
intended_use_permissions.software: permitted by project MIT/LGPL licence statements
intended_use_permissions.reason: Public availability does not establish a distinct licence grant for benchmark PDB and all benchmark materials.

stock_cuda_image.reason: Published CUDA installation and concurrent GPU example support feasibility in principle. Stock image inventory, driver compatibility, conda and MPS availability not supplied or tested. No install or workload run.

size.reason: Input sizes measured from source bytes. Combined host/device peak for two contexts, runtime libraries and compilation not published or measured.

scoring.interface: Read ns_per_day from each process stdout; require two successful pme results, then sum. Preserve steps, elapsed_time, timestep, configuration and hardware metadata.
scoring.reason: No benchmark acceptance threshold or scoring tolerance published. Throughput is hardware-dependent; atom-count reference is not a performance threshold.

repeatability.fixed_configuration: Two independent full-size simulations concurrently on one GPU; each uses --seconds=60. No concurrency or system-size sweep.
repeatability.seeds: Default seed 0 requests distinct generated seeds per Context; actual seed integers not published and benchmark has no seed CLI option.
repeatability.determinism: Same explicit seed would not guarantee identical GPU trajectories.
repeatability.limitations: Published timer calibrates integration step count internally. Workload size and target duration remain fixed; exact step count, exact seed schedule and hard runtime bound are unavailable.

candidates.name: Official OpenMM examples benchmark, release 8.2.0
candidates.status: Executable baseline used by selected article.

gate.reason: Intended-use permission for all benchmark input materials remains unknown.
